ModMetaData.name: Dynamic Mending
ModMetaData.author: SloppyMod
ModMetaData.description: Repair damaged apparel and weapons at a manual or electric mending table, or a fully automated hopper-fed mending station at higher tech. Material and work-time costs scale dynamically with missing HP; failed or risky repairs can cost HP or item quality; all repair work produces waste, reusing Biotech Wastepacks or Vanilla Recycling Expanded trash when those mods are present.
